newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - June 22.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - June 22.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Saudi Arabian press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Prince Ahmed bin Abdul-Aziz says Islamic law is an effective deterrent in preventing weaker members of society from turning to drugs.
- Saudi ambassador to Britain says two British nurses accused of murdering an Australian colleague will have a fair trial.
- More municipal projects to be opened for private bidding, municipal and rural affairs minister says.
- Deputy interior minister says Saudi Arabia is following the case of the Saudi suspect in the al-Khobar bombing last year in which 19 U.S. servicemen were killed.
- Investments in industrial joint ventures in Saudi Arabia are worth 88.8 billion riyals.
- Mecca vice-governor opens a 220-million-riyal recreation project in Jeddah.
